title: Digital Seed
definition: The founding concept of the CADMIES mycelium: a single content-addressed unit of knowledge, planted to grow an interconnected ecosystem of understanding. Every concept in the library descends from this original encoding.

proofs.description: Re-minted from the original Hieros-era genesis block (CID bafyreifek2pbsi22...), the first block ever created in the mycelium

difficulty_levels.beginner: The first seed planted in the garden of knowledge. Everything else grew from here.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A digital seed is a unit of knowledge encoded so its address derives from its content — the same idea always lands at the same place, no matter who plants it or when.
difficulty_levels.expert: Content-addressed genesis: the seed's meaning persists independent of its CID. The original block was lost with its blockstore, yet the concept survived through its source and lore — proof that knowledge, not its address, is what the mycelium preserves.

extra_fields.date_correction_note: Original block carried '2024-10-01' due to a known system clock error on early machines. Actual first work occurred 2025. All dates in this entry are corrected accordingly.
extra_fields.timezone_note: All timestamps UTC (Zulu). Gardener local time is US Central (UTC-5/-6); apparent off-by-one-day discrepancies are timezone artifacts.
extra_fields.note: Founder concept. Lore-grounded: every CADMIES session note references the mycelium this seed began.
